The '''Samhari''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Near-Human]]s who inhabited [[Samhar]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. Their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], covered in vast, [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Tree/Legends|forests]], was near the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Duros Space Run]]; however, the Samhari held themselves aloof from the surrounding territories. Their insularity saw them focus more on their own internal intrigues than those of the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Gazetteer" />

During the period of the [[Republic Dark Age]], the Samhari were considered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to have few friends in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. A brief note on their homeworld was included by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] in his briefing to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Genarra]] shortly before Treece embarked on a [[Operation Influx|mission]] into the Grumani sector. In the missive, Treece expressed ignorance of what had become of the Samhari while the sector was being contested by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Daiman]] and [[Odion]].<ref name="Gazetteer" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] created the Samhari for ''[[The Knight Errant Gazetteer]]'', published on [[StarWars.com]] in [[November 12]], [[2010]]. The gazetteer served as a companion to the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] written by [[John Jackson Miller]].<ref name="Gazetteer" />
